articles.title: ‘Indentured servants’: US green card move will hit thousands of IT workers - Al Jazeera
articles.description: The US is suspending top tech firms, including Microsoft, from a key programme to sponsor foreign workers’ green cards.
articles.content:
The United States government has moved to exclude some of the worlds top tech companies from a programme that allows them to sponsor skilled foreign workers for permanent residency.
